Getting ready for your interview? Not so sure of how you’re going to answer the interview questions? Have no flying experience? No worries, I’ve got YOU!
Here’s a sample Cabin Crew Question & Answer sample especially made for you!


Flight Attendant Interview Questions | WHY SHOULD WE HIRE YOU AS OUR FLIGHT ATTENDANT?

“Why should we hire you as our flight attendant?” What does it really want from you? How could you answer this question? Here, I made a sample answer to help you get through with your flight attendant interview. Good luck! Fly with you soon!

#FlightAttendantInterviewQuestions #WhyShouldWeHireYouAsOurFlightAttendant #Misskaykrizz


Here are the sample answer to the question:

“You should hire me as your flight attendant because I am confident that I am able to do the job that you require and more. As somebody who’s been working on the customer service field, I know how to manage expectations and most especially exceed them through my excellent service. And also, I could tell you that I am a very hardworking person not just because I am here right now telling you this but you see on my track record I was a working student all throughout college. So that means, I was able to manage my time very well, finished my studies in the morning. After that bustling of tables, doing the cashier post, as well as mopping floors nearby fast food chain in our university. Then, at night I still need to study for exam the next day. By that, I can keep my good grades to maintain my scholarship status on the university. This has been something very well ingrain in my personality ever since childhood because we have this strong work ethic in our family and I try to apply that in my life. I plan to keep on applying it throughout my career as a flight attendant. And I am probably the best team player that you will have on your team because I am somebody who strives with working with a team and a lot of other people. I can tell you that I am not very good in a desk job, in something that is monotonous or in routine. But put me in front of people and I excel. That is my specialty and I really like to work with my teammates to achieve a common goal. This where I get my fulfillment in life and that is why I think I am the best fit for this position as a flight attendant. Thank you.”
